init_DPR_retriever: initialize a DPR dense passage retriever with a model file, encoder, and FAISS index configuration
feed_data_DPR: feed query data with entity tokens into the DPR retriever to extract questions and query IDs
run_DPR_retrieval: run the DPR retriever to generate question vectors and retrieve top matching Wikipedia passages with scores
review_DPR_class: review the DPR class that extends Retriever for dense passage retrieval using DPR biencoder models
summarize_DPR_run_method: summarize the DPR run method that returns provenance results mapping query IDs to ranked passage scores and text
